title: Skills
descriptionEmpty: Procedures the agent can follow, in the SKILL.md format.

empty.title: Add a skill
empty.body: A skill is markdown that teaches the agent a repeatable procedure — when to use it, and the steps to follow. Skills follow the SKILL.md standard.
empty.storage: Skills are stored in your sandbox, separately from your files. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
empty.dropHint: Drop .md files or a skill folder to import

manual.name: Write
manual.body: Start from a SKILL.md template and write it here.
manual.title: Write a skill
manual.subtitle: Name it and describe when it applies; the body opens in the editor.
manual.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 64 characters.
manual.descriptionPlaceholder: Extract text and tables from PDFs, fill forms, merge and split files.
manual.descriptionHint: The agent reads only this to decide whether the skill applies, so put the triggers here.

github.name: GitHub
github.body: Paste a file or folder URL. Frontmatter is read for you.
github.title: Import from GitHub
github.subtitle: A single skill file, or a folder of them.
github.urlHint: A file URL (/blob/…), a folder URL (/tree/…), or a raw.githubusercontent.com link.

upload.name: Upload files
upload.body: Pick one or more .md files from your computer.

folder.name: Folder
folder.body: Pick a folder. A SKILL.md subtree becomes one skill; loose .md files become one each.

import.title: Import {{count}} skill
import.subtitle: Review what will be written before it lands in your sandbox.
import.noneBody: No SKILL.md or .md files were found there.

detail.enabledForHint: Skills are enabled per agent, on the draft you are editing.
detail.descriptionPlaceholder: When should the agent reach for this skill?
detail.descriptionHint: The only text the agent sees before loading the body — put the triggers here.
detail.bodyPlaceholder:
# Skill

The instructions the agent follows…
detail.resourceUnsupported: This file can't be previewed here.

delete.title: Delete this skill?
delete.description: This permanently deletes "{{name}}" and any files bundled with it.

detail.loadFailedBody: Bundled skills load their instructions from the publisher's repository, so this needs a network connection.

picker.title: Skills for this agent
picker.addSubtitle: Added skills are switched on for this agent right away.
